metadata.description: PowerShell Management cmdlets for Quest OnDemand

findings.title: Invisible or bidirectional Unicode characters
findings.description: The source contains Unicode control characters that can obscure the visible order or appearance of code.

evidence.snippet: "PreserveExisting": Add new target OneDrive account preserving existing local folders and disconnect the source account​

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Get-SPOAuthenticationCookie' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$password' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
